recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆橢圓形紅血球充滿許多均勻分布的深紫色粗點，另有一顆偏藍大細胞帶細點彩，符合嗜鹼性點彩；周圍紅血球大多正常。
features: Central oval red cell packed with coarse, discrete dark purple granules throughout the cytoplasm
A larger polychromatophilic red cell (lower center) with finer, diffuse stippling
A cell at lower left shows faint fine stippling around central pallor
Background red cells normocytic, normochromic with central pallor; occasional small refractile dot artifacts
Scattered small platelets; no leukocytes in field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a background of normocytic, normochromic red cells. A central elliptical red cell contains numerous coarse, evenly dispersed basophilic granules, and additional polychromatophilic cells show finer diffuse stippling. No intraerythrocytic parasites are identified. Findings are consistent with coarse basophilic stippling; correlation with blood lead level and hemoglobin studies is suggested.

ddx.vs: Pappenheimer bodies are sparse, peripherally clustered and iron-positive, while stippling here fills the cell diffusely.
Maurer clefts accompany visible ring forms and appear as irregular comma-shaped red dots, not uniform blue granules without a parasite.
An overlying platelet is a single granular body with a pale hyalomere rather than many discrete granules within the red cell.
